name: stl4
summary: STL node/tree conformance demo (clang-built C++ — clang-simplified's wasm/demos/stl_features4.cpp: node-based map/set iterator stability + std::function target recovery)

stl4-demo.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Menu launcher: stl4 is a tty app (the STL conformance report on stdout), so
# run it in a terminal window and hold the window open for the verdict — the
# etl-tests pattern. $0 arrives through symlinks; realpath canonicalizes (0263).
here="$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")"
exec term sh -c "$here/stl4; echo; echo '[stl4 demo done — press Enter to close]'; read _"
